storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
He is flesh born from a twisted existence—stitched together from cut skin, a hollow chest cavity, a tainted heart, and invisible chains.

He is placed upon a pedestal, worshipped at the feet, said to possess a pure soul.

What, then, is he? Lost in countless dreams, he asks in confusion; and among the dark-green lake waters and the empty fog, only his own voice echoes back in lonely reply.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
Considering the potential relationship between Pollux's "Sacred Heart" and the Church of the Lightbearers' divine ritual, Mythag formed a research team to conduct a series of inspections and experiments on the heart.

 To Pollux's regret, the "Sacred Heart" had entirely replaced his original heart's function, becoming integrated into his body, making direct removal or replacement impossible.

During observational experiments, researchers discovered that the "Sacred Heart," which resembles an eye pupil, often exhibited subtle tremors and rotations independent of Pollux's will, much like a real eye.

However, light source testing proved the "Sacred Heart" did not possess visual functions. Instead, this activity appeared to be sensitivity to other living beings or objects. In comparative trials with varied items, proximity to items related to dissolution and the silver core triggered the heart's activity more easily.

Its activity was particularly pronounced in front of Dissolutes and Awakeners. After Pollux actively used the "Sacred Heart's" power, the physical and chemical properties of ordinary items remained unchanged. However, when directed at dissoluted items and creatures, a remarkable expansion of dissolution occurred. Living organisms visibly in the early stages of dissolution rapidly accelerated towards the late stages. The more severe the dissolution originally suffered by the organisms, the faster this spread occurred.

In experiments with strict protective measures on Awakeners, the subjects reported a sense of approaching dark danger when faced with the "Sacred Heart's" power, prompting the experiment to be quickly halted.

After a stern explanation from the school, Pollux promised not to use his power against Awakeners. Due to Pollux's cooperation and excellent self-control, Mythag did not impose mandatory controlling items on him, but instead arranged regular health checks and power training.

It is said that after hearing the experimental results, Awakener Winkle almost fainted screaming and posted notices prohibiting Pollux from approaching on the doors of her laboratory and dormitory. The school repeatedly tried to persuade her to no avail, and Pollux graciously stated that he would respect Winkle's wishes.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Compared to Castor's active and studious attitude, Pollux's approach to the world is one of quiet vigilance.

He observes, he thinks, he doubts. It was his meticulous consideration and caution that once enabled their successful escape from the church's heavy control. From a young age, he learned to gauge the intentions of others, to lie, and to hide his true thoughts behind a disarming smile. Even with his intimately close brother, he would subconsciously use a relaxed demeanor to soothe and reassure.

"It's okay."

"It will be alright."

Beneath the shadow of a giant, the weak must exhaust every means to grasp a single glimmer of hope.

Having endured a long period of forced forgetting and deception, he now tolerates no danger or mistakes. Even after heeding Thais's advice and coming to Mythag, he remained profoundly vigilant for a long time.

To other Awakeners, Pollux appears as a quiet, patient, and friendly individual who often offers a gentle smile. But seasoned elders who see him can only sigh at the profound difference between the two brothers.

According to Thais, even in her presence, Pollux will intentionally or unintentionally position himself between her and Castor—since reclaiming his memory, he no longer wishes for Castor to always be his sole protector.

Jenkin once earnestly complained to the Keeper about Pollux's duality, claiming that when she "accidentally" picked up an item belonging to Castor, she witnessed his expression turn terrifying in an instant. "His usual good temper must be fake! He's the type who would eat children in private!"

However, after witnessing the Keeper's true power, Pollux's attitude underwent a complete transformation. He claims to have learned the truth of the world from that great soul and has now taken the Keeper as his new, unwavering faith.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
In the original design of the God of Fate, Pollux was probably never meant to be born.

Initially, only Castor had been successfully created in the artificial Twin Divi experiment. Just as this single, clueless embryo was to be disposed of, Pollux struggled and twisted himself free from his brother's flesh. He absorbed his life force, yet in doing so, he also saved it—from that moment on, their flesh, souls, and fates were irrevocably intertwined.

In the monotonous routine of the church's teaching, their lives and destinies were identical. But with the start of the "Holy Transformation" ritual, the pain and ruthless torment awakened something within Pollux—a defiance of his ordained fate as a Divus. The two children committed the boldest act of their lives: they sketched a world map from an outdated book and escaped from one false world to another imagined one.

After the fragile, fleeting beautiful dream shattered, the cruel punishment that followed did not crush their souls, yet that merciless fork in fate had already driven them apart.

Juliette ordered the two to be separated and "re-educated." Castor, submerged in the pool of sin, remained unaware that the tortures they had imagined were never inflicted upon Pollux. Instead, with an air of near mercy, Juliette ended the physical punishment and soon released Pollux from the dark room's confinement, steering him instead toward intense and rigorous theological teachings.

Pollux's unyielding doubts transformed into a deep-seated unease and fear under Juliette's utterly calm gaze; she must have mastered a method of control he could not resist, to appear so completely at ease.

He struggled, he disguised himself, and he never gave up. It seemed he did so many things... but what, in the end, had he truly accomplished? In the mirror, only the soul of a stranger remained, dutifully wearing the crown of the Divus.

He, and all their shared memories, had been completely forgotten.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
His entire life was lived under manipulated strings, and the script written long ago was a laughable lie that made him constantly lose, forget, and miss out. 

 When he was young, what he desired most was to freely flap his wings and see the world beyond that lake. 

 It wasn't until he lost everything for this wish that he could no longer regard such a light and carefree life as his ultimate dream. 

 Endless rage ignited that pitch-black heart, and the pain and hatred he repressed like blood needed to be washed away with the deaths of those false believers.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: The Apostle of the Lightbearer, scion of the White Night, One who Dispels Darkness, Divus of the Divine Heart—I, Pollux, have answered your call. I offer unto you my power over Darkness, and my soul forged of Light.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Your bestowed gift I shall wield, with deepest gratitude.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Your generosity and compassion are without end; I shall meditate upon the warmth of your light.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: This heart, which once heeded the divine will, now beats closer to yours.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: In my time following Juliette, I committed grave errors and was undeserving of your trust. Yet you chose me anyway... Be assured, I shall seek my conviction once more. As the Divus, I will not disappoint my subjects again, nor will I disappoint you.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: The Darkness... the Darkness spread by Juliette's incantation, it has lingered in my mind... And now, a single ray of light has pierced it! Could that faint glimmer be trying to tell me something?

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: I see it! That light, shining deep within my consciousness—it brightens! It calls to me...

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: Chained in shackles, bathed in dark sludge, I shall chase that ray of light, no matter what... Is this what you wanted to teach me?

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: The sins of the past are committed; I shall flee them no longer. I must also correct the Lantern's mistakes and guide the strayed back to the true path. Let me bear my sins. Then, I shall answer the light of your call and tread the right path as the Divus.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: Please illuminate me, my guiding light! By your light, I have now seen all that must be seen... I shall use this cursed form to purify all that has passed, and let all that is to come bask in your radiance!

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Yours is a compassionate soul, to forgive one so burdened by sin. I feel the pure, radiant light within your spirit—it outshines the brightest flame. Perhaps you can guide my heart, which has lost its way...

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: In our childhood, Castor and I served together as the Twin Divi. I always thought him too dull, too clumsy, that I alone must guide our future. Now, having witnessed the path you walk, I see the world's foundation is built and paved by those like you and him: the steadfast and the upright.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: I have lost my light, and this blind suffering torments me. I beg you, save my lost soul. Please, take my hand as I guide yours over this Holy Heart in my chest. Please, guide toward the light...

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Ah... now I see! I see such mighty power, I see the world's truth... I have erred in the past. You are the real Lightbearer! Please allow me to become your loyal Apostle. This heart, born for the Lightbearer, shall henceforth beat and tremble in your service only...

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: You have lead me and granted me Light. For so long I was blinded by false purpose. Now, I have found my true calling: to correct the ignorant and distorted heretics and bring everlasting Light to this world. I know of your selflessness; You have no need for my devotion or offerings. Then I beg this: allow me to walk at your side, to record every sacred word and deed, that they may guide my path through the darkness.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: D-Do you have an order for me, my Light? Your Apostle stands ever-ready to hear your teaching.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: I was told this abyssal darkness was worthy of faith. That it was a blessing I would deliver unto the faithful. Now, this darkness has long since corroded me, merging with my very being... Yet the heart that beats within this sinful vessel remains a sanctum that can never be tainted. Rest assured, I shall use the power it has bestowed upon me to bring true benediction to this world!

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: The one who can lead all from the mist is the true Lightbearer, forged of purest silver. The sinless paradise preached by Juliette is, in truth, built upon the bones of the faithful. As the Divus, I shall sow the new gospel among all who are worthy of salvation.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: In my youth, I was determined to break free from that place. It brought me only pain, and I deemed it unworthy of longing. But now, granted a second life, I see that freedom is not my sole desire. The true meaning of being Divus is to witness the devoted, hopeful, and grateful countenances of the followers when they learn redemption is at hand.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: I once hated many things—the impolite servants, the disrespectful attendants, the heretics who defiled the Light... But now? I hate the Lantern. Only the Lantern! Juliette and her Church brought upon my brother and I irreparable pain. I swear upon my title as the former Divus, I shall never permit such pain to befall another!

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: My Light, ever since I received your guidance, I believe I have embarked upon the one true path. Yet your rather dim-witted believer remains perplexed by one question: does the legendary sinless paradise also fall under your dominion? "It doesn't exist," you say...? Could it be... you mean to say that paradise exists here, in the mortal world, within the pure hearts of the righteous?

daily.title: Chat: About Aigis and Jenkin
daily.content: What an unfortunate child. Since she has devoted herself to your cause, she shall surely attain ultimate redemption. But why has her monkey-like companion also received your mercy? That evil child even stole my sacramentals! A torrent of sins must rage within her soul. Ahh, the disrespect! THE UTTER DISRESPECT!

daily.title: Chat: About Murphy
daily.content: I heard she was once a Divine Maiden. But with such uncouth manners and brutish behavior... What? She cannot recite a single prayer? Such profound impiety... I feel a vicarious shame for her deity.

daily.title: Chat: About Miryam
daily.content: Ah, that overzealous believer. The world might see her as a raving madwoman. Though she once committed evil, such fervent devotion—the will to offer everything to her god—is a resoluteness most ordinary souls could never muster. What do I think of her, you ask? ...I only feel... a certain commiseration. A kinship, with one cast adrift in the same turbulent sea.

daily.title: Chat: About Salvador
daily.content: That priest's blind pursuit of redemption is the height of folly. Divine grace should be bestowed solely upon the devout and the righteous. If even he, an apostle, lacks the discernment to separate the wheat from the chaff, rewarding unrepentant sinners and allowing them to defile his deity's kingdom... is that not the most profound betrayal of his faith and of the righteous souls he claims to serve?

daily.title: Chat: About Castor
daily.content: Ha... After all this time, he hasn't changed one bit. I never imagined as a child that I would be the one to hurt my brother—that I'd come to owe him so much it aches with shame, for a fate we did not choose. We have suffered enough separation. Now that I am back, I swear: nothing will ever separate us again. Not even death itself.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: I shall bring Guidance and Judgment; may the White Night purge your sins!

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: I will herald your glorious name, and all that is unclean and impure shall be purified by its radiance.

battle.title: Rouse
battle.content: I shall walk the path of light until my final breath.

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: May the Lightbearer's radiance pierce this endless night!

traphase.title: Chat: About Castor
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Stop being so wishy-washy, Castor. Come at me! Do you think I'd lose to you?

traphase.title: Chat: About Caecus
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Unable to become stronger? Perhaps your soul is too unacceptably filthy.

traphase.title: Chat: About Tulu
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Since you are a god, why do you turn a blind eye to the world's festering evil?

traphase.title: Chat: About Arachne
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: A so-called divinity who meddles with the fates of others. Your sins do not escape my sight!
